answer: Reaching the lantern of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Work waits on the wharf until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the umber of the next round.
